src.label: Australian Department of Agriculture (Micor) — Egypt, dogs (based on Egyptian Ministry of Agriculture correspondence, 18 December 2025)

head: Microchip first, then a rabies vaccine at least 21 days before travel, plus a government vet certificate.
lines: The Australian agriculture department says it received these rules from the Egyptian Ministry of Agriculture in December 2025: an ISO microchip whose number is on every document, and a valid rabies vaccination certificate.
The rabies vaccine must be given after the microchip, at least 21 days before travel, and still be valid on entry.

An official veterinary health certificate from a government-authorised vet in the country of origin is also required, with original documents. This is Australian guidance, so confirm with the Egyptian ministry.
